news.title: Burgum defends white nationalist group’s Independence Day march, citing First Amendment
news.summary: Interior Secretary Doug Burgum on Sunday said he disagreed with the beliefs of a white nationalist group that marched through the nation’s capital on Independence Day but defended their right to do so, despite concerns from local residents. Approximately 400 masked people wearing paraphernalia with the logo of the Patriot Front white supremacist group marched…
